# AnimalShow

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/animal_lineup.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal_lineup.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

On an animal of AnimalLineup: the clips it plays one after the other.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `clips` | `std::vector<int>` | Clip indices to play, empty: the bind pose. |
| `at` | `size_t` | Index of the current one. |
| `left` | `float` | Seconds of the current clip left. |

## Notes

Made and advanced by AnimalLineup only.
